explanation: Rodin first designed it to sit above his huge doorway The Gates of Hell, inspired by Dante's Inferno. It was meant to show Dante himself, pondering his poem.

claims.text: Degas, Maillol and Claudel did not make The Thinker.
Rodin first conceived The Thinker as part of The Gates of Hell, a monumental doorway inspired by Dante's Inferno.
The Thinker was originally intended to represent Dante contemplating his poem.
